`MF_SPECIAL` is **1**, `MF_SOLID` is **2**, `MF_SHOOTABLE` is **4**, `MF_NOGRAVITY` is **0x200**, `MF_MISSILE` is **0x10000**, and `MF_DROPPED` is **0x20000**. `MF2_SEEKERMISSILE` is **0x40000000**. `MF3_FLOORHUGGER` is **1**, `MF3_CEILINGHUGGER` is **2**, and `MF3_ISMONSTER` is **0x2000**. `DF_NO_MONSTERS` is **1<<12**. `LEVEL2_NOMONSTERS` is **0x8000**. `RF_TRANSFERFRIENDLINESS` is **1** and `RF_NOCHECKPOSITION` is **2**. `CHAN_BODY` is **4** and `ATTN_IDLE` is **1.001**. `ONFLOORZ` is **-2147483648** and `ONCEILINGZ` is **2147483647**. One-eighth gravity is **1/8**.

A missing kind returns false. A monster class default returns false when `DF_NO_MONSTERS` or `LEVEL2_NOMONSTERS` is set, before any spawn. Tid **0** fires from the source once; a tid-0 iterator yields nothing further. Any other tid walks the host spot list. Each spot builds a fresh destination iterator. Destination **0** launches once toward the forced actor, which may be null. A non-zero destination launches only for actors the iterator yields, and an empty list launches nothing. Floor-hugger class defaults use `ONFLOORZ` and win over the ceiling bit. Ceiling-hugger defaults use `ONCEILINGZ`. Any other `z` except `ONFLOORZ` subtracts the spot's floor clip. A null spawn is skipped. A spawned actor takes the new tid, always plays its spawn sound, and targets the spot. Non-zero gravity clears `MF_NOGRAVITY`. Gravity **1** on a non-monster sets gravity to **1/8**. Gravity **0** sets `MF_NOGRAVITY` and leaves the gravity value. A destination runs host intercept velocity and, for a seeker, stores that actor as the tracer. No destination uses the supplied angle, degree sine and cosine times speed, and `vspeed`. A missile's speed is the full velocity length, including Z, and only then does a floor or ceiling hugger on the spawned actor zero `Vel.Z`. `MF_SPECIAL` adds `MF_DROPPED`. A missile that fails its spawn check is destroyed and does not clear a previous success. A non-missile that fails its location check clears counters and is destroyed. Success is sticky.

Damage with tid **0** visits only the first actor. Any other tid visits each host actor. Only `MF_SHOOTABLE` actors count. A positive amount is host damage and does not change health here. A non-positive amount heals only while health is below spawn health, caps at spawn health, and copies that health onto the player. A full actor with a non-positive amount still counts. Removal keeps a live player body. Any other actor that is not a map actor is left alone; a map actor clears counters and is destroyed. Raise of a missing thing or a thing with no raise state changes nothing. Otherwise X and Y velocity become **0**, Z is kept, and solid plus default height and radius are applied. A failed position check restores flags and size and does not ask whether a resurrect is allowed. A failed resurrect keeps the raised size and solid flag. Success plays `vile/raise` on `CHAN_BODY` at `ATTN_IDLE`, revives, copies friendliness with `changeTarget` false when the flag is set and a raiser exists, and enters the raise state. `RF_NOCHECKPOSITION` skips the position check. Can-raise always restores the original flags and size and returns the position check. A null velocity actor is unchanged. Without add, actor and player velocity are zeroed, then the vector is added to the actor. Bob adds only X and Y to the player.
